skills.skill_desc:
Paquito gains a stack each time he casts a skill. At 3 stacks, he enters the <font color="a6aafb">Champ Stance</font> and enhances his next skill.
Paquito's enhanced skills have no cooldown and deal (+2*Hero Level)% extra damage to minions.

After casting any enhanced skill, Paquito gains 60% Movement Speed and (+2*Hero Level)% Damage Reduction for 1.2s.

Paquito throws a punch in the target direction, dealing 210<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit and gaining a 150<font color="fba51f"> (+135% Total Physical Attack)</font> shield.

<font color="a6aafb">Champ Stance</font>: The damage is increased to 350<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>, and the shield value is increased to 140% for 2.5s (normal and enhanced shields can stack).

Paquito dashes forward and throws a jab, dealing 200<font color="fba51f"> (+165% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in his path and at the destination.

<font color="a6aafb">Champ Stance</font>: Paquito's jab becomes fiercer, dealing 300<font color="fba51f"> (+210% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit.
The jab stops upon hitting a hero or creep.

Paquito launches an elbow strike at enemies in the target direction, dealing 250<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and knocking them back to the destination.
He then throws a haymaker, dealing 300<font color="fba51f"> (+90% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and slowing them by 75% for 1s, before darting backward.

<font color="a6aafb">Champ Stance</font>: After knocking enemies back to the destination, Paquito launches an uppercut instead, dealing 400<font color="fba51f"> (+120% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and knocking them airborne for 0.5s.
